Container.Name: awtrix-ai-status
Container.Overview: Display Claude/Codex activity on an Ulanzi TC001 running AWTRIX3.
Container.Description:
Display Claude/Codex activity on an Ulanzi TC001 running AWTRIX3.
**Before you click Apply on first install:**
1. From your Unraid host shell (Terminal plugin or SSH), prepare appdata: `mkdir -p /mnt/user/appdata/awtrix-ai-status && curl -fsSL -o /mnt/user/appdata/awtrix-ai-status/config.json https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tarakanof/awtrix-ai-status/main/config.example.json` 2. Edit it (`vi` or your preferred editor) and set `awtrix.http_base_url` to your AWTRIX device URL (e.g. `http://192.168.0.14`). 3. Generate a token: `openssl rand -hex 32` — paste into the STATUS_TOKEN field above. 4. Click Apply.
**Verify after start (from the Unraid host shell, NOT the Console icon — the runtime image is distroless and has no shell):** `docker exec awtrix-ai-status /awtrix-ai-status doctor` Every check should be `[OK]`. Replace `awtrix-ai-status` with whatever name you gave the container in the template UI.
**Upgrade:** Click "Force Update" in the Unraid Docker UI. Pulls the latest `:latest` image; in-flight requests drain on stop.
**Uninstall:** Stop + Remove the container. The appdata folder is preserved unless you delete it manually.
See https://github.com/tarakanof/awtrix-ai-status for full documentation.

Config.Name: Config dir
Config.Description: Bind mount; on first start copy config.example.json from the repo into this folder as config.json and edit awtrix.http_base_url to match your device.

Config.Name: STATUS_TOKEN
Config.Description: Bearer token producers must send on /v1/* writes. Choose anything random; copy it to your producer hosts.

Config.Name: CONFIG_PATH
Config.Description: Path to config.json inside the container. Default matches the bind mount above; only change if you renamed the file.

Config.Name: STATUS_TLS_CERT_FILE
Config.Description: Optional. Path to a PEM cert inside the container to enable HTTPS. Set both this and STATUS_TLS_KEY_FILE; bind-mount your cert dir separately. See README's TLS section.

Config.Name: STATUS_TLS_KEY_FILE
Config.Description: Optional. Path to the matching PEM key inside the container.

Config.Name: STATUS_HEALTHCHECK_INSECURE
Config.Description: Optional. Set to '1' if you enabled TLS with a self-signed cert and want the in-image healthcheck to skip TLS verification.
